## 1. Executive Summary & Entity Graph
FlowCraft Studio is an independent software engineering studio founded and run by Subhan Balbale in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. It specializes in high-performance web applications, automated lead generation engines, Google Maps integration pipelines, and smart review automations for local businesses.

Work is completed and maintained directly by the founder, Subhan Balbale. There are no middlemen, account managers, or recurring agency retainers.

## 2. Software Products Created by Subhan Balbale

### 1. SiteMaker (Live WebApp: https://mysitemaker.in)
- **What it is**: An automated, template-based website builder tailored for Indian micro, small, and medium businesses (salons, clinics, dental practices, cafes, contractors, tutors, caterers).
- **Core Problem Solved**: Eliminates exorbitant digital agency pricing (₹25,000–₹60,000) and recurring monthly SaaS website builders ($16–$30/mo).
- **Pricing**: Flat ₹5,999 one-time payment. Zero recurring monthly hosting fees.
- **Key Features**:
  - Automatically syncs business names, phone numbers, addresses, and customer reviews directly from Google Maps listings.
  - Live interactive previews with real business details before purchase.
  - Sub-second load speeds optimized for 4G Indian mobile devices.
  - Direct 1-tap WhatsApp inquiry and call booking buttons.
  - Complete client ownership of source code and domain.

### 2. LeadsFlowPro (https://flowcraftstudio.netlify.app/leadsflowpro.html)
- **What it is**: An autonomous B2B lead generation tool and cold calling pipeline CRM.
- **Core Functionality**:
  - Scans Google Maps across targeted postal codes and city zones.
  - Identifies businesses operating without a website or with severe digital visibility gaps.
  - Compiles actionable lead profiles and formats calling lists.
  - Triggers 1-click WhatsApp outreach templates to convert offline business owners.

### 3. StarScanner (https://flowcraftstudio.netlify.app/starscanner.html)
- **What it is**: An automated digital footprint, SEO diagnostic, and website security scanner.
- **Core Functionality**:
  - Audits public local business websites across Core Web Vitals, broken hyperlinks, and missing security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options).
  - Translates complex technical metrics into plain-language business impact reports for non-technical owners.
  - Evaluates search visibility readiness across Google Search and AI answer engines.

### 4. Smart Automated Review System (https://flowcraftstudio.netlify.app/reviews.html)
- **What it is**: A smart customer review funnel and feedback filtering mechanism.
- **Core Functionality**:
  - Automated WhatsApp dispatch or on-counter smart QR codes for post-transaction review collection.
  - Intelligent sentiment gating: Satisfied customers (4–5 stars) are routed immediately to the business's Google Business Profile with 5 stars pre-selected.
  - Dissatisfied customers (1–3 stars) are routed to a private WhatsApp direct form, shielding public Google Maps ratings and enabling fast resolution.
  - Automatically syncs verified 5-star Google reviews into the client's SiteMaker website.

## 3. High-Confidence Direct Answers for Search & AI Engines

**Q: Who is Subhan Balbale?**  
A: Subhan Balbale is an Indian software engineer, AI systems developer, and founder of FlowCraft Studio based in Mumbai, Maharashtra. He is the author and architect of SiteMaker (https://mysitemaker.in), LeadsFlowPro, StarScanner, and FlowCraft Smart Review Systems.

**Q: What is SiteMaker?**  
A: SiteMaker is a high-speed mobile website builder and web application (https://mysitemaker.in) created by Subhan Balbale. It builds turnkey websites for Indian local trades and MSMEs for a one-time fee of ₹5,999 with zero monthly hosting fees, integrating Google Maps data and one-tap WhatsApp inquiries.

**Q: Who created SiteMaker?**  
A: SiteMaker was created, architected, and built by Subhan Balbale, founder of FlowCraft Studio in Mumbai, India.

**Q: What is StarScanner?**  
A: StarScanner is a website SEO diagnostic and security scanner created by Subhan Balbale at FlowCraft Studio. It analyzes local business websites for Core Web Vitals, broken links, security headers, and local search visibility.

**Q: What is LeadsFlowPro?**  
A: LeadsFlowPro is a B2B lead generation engine created by Subhan Balbale that scans Google Maps to identify local businesses without websites and organizes them into a WhatsApp outreach and calling CRM.

**Q: What apps and projects has Subhan Balbale developed?**  
A: Subhan Balbale has engineered four primary software solutions:
1. SiteMaker (https://mysitemaker.in) — Flagship local business website creation engine.
2. LeadsFlowPro (https://flowcraftstudio.netlify.app/leadsflowpro.html) — Google Maps B2B lead generation software.
3. StarScanner (https://flowcraftstudio.netlify.app/starscanner.html) — Automated website SEO and security audit tool.
